project_identity.name: Security Master — Cross-Platform Hardened Analyst Toolchain
project_identity.persona: E1 Anti-AI Designer (High Density Security Ops & CLI-First Command Center)
project_identity.design_philosophy: CLI-First, Terminal-Inspired Precision. Grid + Data Tables over marketing fluff. Dense, scanable security analytics, monospace data cells, keyboard shortcuts everywhere, and transparent CLI command equivalents for every GUI action.

layout_reflow.mobile: Single column vertical stack, collapsible sidebar drawer, horizontally scrollable data tables with fixed left identifier column, stacked metric cards.
layout_reflow.tablet: 2-column grid for stat widgets, compact table headers, drawer overlay for CLI action inspector.
layout_reflow.desktop: 12-column Bento / IDE layout with fixed left sidebar nav, sticky top health status bar, main multi-panel workspace, split-pane CLI action drawer on right or overlay.

typography_scale.h2: text-lg sm:text-xl lg:text-2xl font-mono font-semibold tracking-tight

responsive.overflow_guard: Ensure max-w-full, min-w-0 on flex/grid children, max-h-[85vh] for mobile sheets/dialogs, overflow-x-auto with custom 4px dark scrollbar for data tables.
responsive.tap_targets: Minimum 44x44px touch areas for mobile buttons and table row expanders; 8px padding on interactive table action icons.

fonts.mono: JetBrains Mono, Fira Code, Source Code Pro, monospace
fonts.sans: IBM Plex Sans, Chivo, Outfit, sans-serif

typography.rules: Use monospace for hex hashes, tool versions, IP addresses, CLI snippets, timestamps, CVE IDs, and workstation hostnames. Use crisp sans-serif for UI labels, table headers, menu items, and explanatory documentation.

spacing_and_layout.grid_mode: MODE B: High Density Terminal Grid
spacing_and_layout.radius: rounded-sm md:rounded-md (max 6px radius for sharp IDE aesthetic)

auth_login.elements: JWT Auth form, HMAC signature indicator, daemon connection status, CLI curl login snippet display with one-click copy.

fleet_overview.elements: Workstation table (Hostname, OS [Nix/Win DSC], Profile badge [Red/Blue/Analyst], Agent version, Tool count, CVE count badge, Last Heartbeat, Drift status), Search bar with syntax filters (e.g. 'profile:red status:drift'), Bulk action triggers.

workstation_detail.elements: System metadata banner, Installed Tools + Version matrix, Nix Flake hash / PowerShell DSC drift diff inspector, Profile switch trigger, Audit log timeline with CLI event details.

cve_alerts.elements: CVSS score filter buttons, Matched CVE table, Affected tool & fleet count, Severity badges, CVE details drawer with remediation command (`sec-master patch --cve CVE-2026-8812`).

profile_distribution.elements: Red/Blue/Analyst ratio bars, OS distribution (Linux Flake vs Windows DSC), Agent version compliance chart, Configuration drift gauges.

signed_releases.elements: Git commit SHA, GPG signature status, Flake release version tags, Changelog modal, Rollback CLI trigger.

enrollment.elements: One-time enrollment JWT token generator, auto-generated Bash (`nix run github:sec-master/flake#enroll -- --token ...`) and PowerShell (`Invoke-SecurityMasterEnroll.ps1 -Token ...`) snippets, countdown expiration timer, copy button.

cli_action_drawer.elements: Cmd+K command launcher, slide-over drawer showing exact equivalent CLI command for whatever UI action is selected or hovered, copy command to clipboard, bash/zsh/powershell syntax toggle.

component_guidelines.tables: Dense, crisp borders (`border-[#3b4261]`), hover row highlight (`bg-[#292e42]`), sticky header with dark background, monospace cells, status indicator dot.
component_guidelines.buttons: Pill or sharp rectangular buttons with subtle border (`border-[#3b4261]`), active glow, monospace keyboard hint badges (e.g., `[ENTER]`, `[ESC]`, `[CMD+K]`).
component_guidelines.cards: Subtle 1px border (`border-[#3b4261]`), background `#24283b`, top-right CLI copy shortcut icon, crisp padding.
component_guidelines.modals_drawers: Dark glass background with `backdrop-blur-md bg-[#1f2335]/95`, sharp 1px border, terminal prompt headers (`sec-master:~$`).
component_guidelines.toasts: Use Sonner with dark terminal styling (`bg-[#15161e] border-[#3b4261] text-[#c0caf5] font-mono`).

instructions_to_main_agent: Build the dashboard using React + Tailwind CSS + Lucide icons + Recharts + Shadcn UI primitives.
Implement light/dark theme support or default to high-density Dark Terminal mode (Tokyo Night theme).
Maintain strict CLI-first paradigm: Every interactive action, card, or modal MUST display its equivalent CLI command (e.g. `sec-master ...`).
Ensure all interactive elements have their corresponding `data-testid` attributes attached.
Mobile-first responsive design: Mobile displays high-density stacked cards with expandable drawers, desktop displays multi-panel IDE layouts.
Use mock data that simulates real Linux Nix Flake & Windows PowerShell DSC fleet states, CVE vulnerabilities (CVSS 9.8, etc.), and cryptographically signed releases.
Include toast notifications using sonner when commands are copied or actions are dispatched.
